# Pairwise Skill Comparison Prompt

Compare exactly two skill packages or validated snapshots. Inventory both before semantic judgment.

Build a matrix for identity, users, triggers and negatives, outputs, workflow and state, authority, tools, context architecture, prompts, references, scripts, assets, evals, portability, provenance, lifecycle, strengths, weaknesses, and evidence gaps. Distinguish shared lineage from independent support and preserve context-dependent variants or contradictions.

Recommend improvements for A, B, both, neither, composition, or boundary refactoring. Route read-only findings to `skill-optimizer` handoffs or topology changes to `skill-refactor`. Ask before generating or applying downstream master prompts.
